goal: Make settings.json and banlist.json writes atomic so a crash or I/O error can't leave a corrupted file
Protects node operators from broken config or ban lists after an interrupted write
reviewability: Ready to review now, latest push resolved the last open naming concern with no material request outstanding
Earlier concerns about error wording and tmp-file accumulation were already fixed with code and tests
agreement: Strong support because it closes a real corruption hazard with tests to back it (winterrdog, Herb-ops)
Nonblocking objection: original test didn't verify rename behavior and error messages were misleading, later fixed (Herb-ops)
Nonblocking objection: risk of future callers bypassing atomic writing, addressed by always making the helper atomic (winterrdog)
Nonblocking objection: naming asymmetry between WriteJson and ReadSettings, resolved by author's follow-up commit (winterrdog)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes a real but narrow corruption risk in banlist.json and settings.json writes
Benefit reaches node operators who hit a crash or disk error mid-write, avoiding a broken config or ban list on next start
Impact is limited since it only touches two auxiliary files rather than wallet or chainstate data, and no reported incident is cited
